claim: An established Apple Tree spawns fruit on a stored interval of 1.65 to 2.5 days with a standing cap of 4; fruit per day cannot be derived from those two numbers alone.

evidence.reference: SpawnerSystem schedules against Clock.Days; apple spawner interval and cap from the research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405317435.

notes: Spawn quantity, blocked accumulation and collection still need tracing. Felling yield is separate from fruit.
